description: Find retailers in Thrifle's return-policy database by name fragment and/or category (e.g. 'Fashion', 'Electronics', 'Home'). Returns slim rows with the return window and a link. With no arguments it returns the category list and total count. Use it when get_return_policy says a retailer was not found, or to list retailers in a category.

category.description: Category name as shown on thrifle.com/return-policy

query.description: Name fragment, e.g. 'best' matches Best Buy

name: search_return_policies
title: Search the return-policy database
